messages:
People Ops: Quick submission for the review kickoff: a micro-playbook (pasteable) for people who hate long forms. Goal: make every self-review readable in 30s and make manager replies action-focused. Thoughts? :eyes:

ryan: Love the 30s constraint. Can we make a variant for manager-level promotions (more emphasis on leadership signals)?

mina: +1. Also include a single field where ICs can drop a dashboard link or PR link so claims are verifiable.

People Ops: Good calls. Draft below includes an IC version and a manager-signal variant, plus a 3-line manager reply rubric. Paste-and-go.

```
MICRO SELF-REVIEW (IC, 6 lines max)
1) Impact in one sentence: "What I shipped and why it mattered"
2) Scope: "What you owned / not owned" (1 short phrase)
3) Top evidence (1 link or metric)
4) One challenge + what you learned (1 line, optional)
5) Ask: "What I want from my manager/team next" (1 line)
6) Quick metric link: <dashboard | PR | ticket> (optional)

MANAGER-LEVEL VARIANT (add 1 extra line)
+ Leadership signal: "How I influenced cross-team outcomes or coached others" (1 sentence)

MANAGER REPLY RUBRIC (3 short prompts)
- Amplify: "Which result should we highlight and how?"
- Next bet: "What's the best next step to scale impact?"
- Growth nudge: "One focused skill to develop this quarter"
```

tara: This is great. Could we also provide two sample one-liners for folks who get stuck? Helps reduce writer's block.

People Ops: Yup, added two quick samples in thread: 
- Sample A (feature): "Delivered X feature that cut support tickets by 22% for paying customers; scope: EU rollout; evidence: grafana.link/xyz; ask: prioritise QA time for broader rollout."
- Sample B (platform/infra): "Reduced inference cost by 15% on heavy routes via batching and cache; scope: enterprise routes only; evidence: pr/456; ask: align on owner to extend to low-volume routes."

leo: Can we include a tiny interviewer-feedback spin-off? Hiring teams want 30s interview blurbs too.

People Ops: Sure — here's a 30s interviewer note template to drop into panel feedback: 
```
INTERVIEWER BLURB (30s)
- Strengths (1 line): e.g., system design clarity, pragmatic trade-offs
- Concern (1 line): e.g., limited infra experience, needs mentorship
- Recommendation (one word): hire / maybe / no-hire
```

hrbot: Reminder: I'll attach this micro-playbook to the review kickoff email and the 'how to write a review' doc. Use the accept emoji to approve copy.

mina: Approved. Minor wording tweak: change 'concern' -> 'development area' in the interviewer blurb.

People Ops: Updated. Shipping this as final in the doc and email template. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
